subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in CMBA-10. (R)MTH (the reality of methodology) is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what *real* methodology — not just the concept — looks like when crossed with the affinity dynamics of post-Coleman/Taylor black creativity. Note the title abbreviates as AF.DY but the actual termId is AFL-DY (affinity dynamics, not just 'affinity'). MTH is fed by IST-PT (isolated particulars) and LANG-DY (language dynamics), and SOC-RT-DEVF (social reality diversification) feeds MTH directly. IST-PT is itself fed by IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) outputs to RT-DY (reality dynamics) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). LANG-DY also feeds PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). Structural argument: real methodology requires *three* distinct upstream constituents — isolated particulars (themselves produced by infrastructure dynamics convergent with vibrational dynamics), language dynamics, and social reality diversification. Multi-diversification as a parallel structure produces reality dynamics and extended functionalism. The progressional-continuance → accelerated-functionalism sub-chain runs separately. The diagram captures Braxton's structural claim about the post-Coleman/Taylor methodological turn: it required infrastructure-vibrational-grounded isolated particulars, language reorganization, and social-reality diversification together — not any single intervention.
